body.name: Endpoint-safe joint cross-fitted logistic-series learner
body.construction:
Put \(L_{a,J}(x)=\log\{d_a(x)\vee e^{-J}\}\).  For each fold \(k\), define
\[
 \eta_J(x;\alpha_0,\alpha_1,\beta)
 =\alpha_1L_{1,J}(x)-\alpha_0L_{0,J}(x)
   +\sum_{j=1}^J\beta_jB_{j,J}(x),
 \qquad p_J(x;\alpha_0,\alpha_1,\beta)=\Lambda\{\eta_J(x;\alpha_0,\alpha_1,\beta)\}.
\]
Let \(\Theta_J\) be the closed convex set of \((\alpha_0,\alpha_1,\beta)\in[0,J]^2\times[-J,J]^J\) for which
\[
 e^{-J}\le p_J(x;\alpha_0,\alpha_1,\beta)\le1-e^{-J}
 \quad\text{for every }x\in[0,1].
\]
The fitted parameter \((\widehat\alpha_{0,-k},\widehat\alpha_{1,-k},\widehat\beta_{-k})\) is the unique maximizer over \(\Theta_{J_n}\) of
\[
 \sum_{i\notin I_k}\left[A_i\log p_{J_n}(X_i;\alpha_0,\alpha_1,\beta)
 +(1-A_i)\log\{1-p_{J_n}(X_i;\alpha_0,\alpha_1,\beta)\}\right]
 -e^{-J_n}\left(\alpha_0^2+\alpha_1^2+\sum_{j=1}^{J_n}\beta_j^2\right).
\]
Strict concavity of the ridge makes the maximizer unique.  Set
\[
 \widehat\eta_{-k}(x)=\eta_{J_n}(x;\widehat\alpha_{0,-k},\widehat\alpha_{1,-k},\widehat\beta_{-k}),
 \qquad
 \widehat\pi_{1,-k}(x)=\Lambda\{\widehat\eta_{-k}(x)\},
 \qquad
 \widehat\pi_{0,-k}(x)=1-\widehat\pi_{1,-k}(x).
\]
Thus every fitted pair is binary coherent and the clipped log coordinates make its endpoint values finite.
inputs: the prespecified two endpoint charts and spline dictionary
the deterministic compact probability-range and ridge rules
